title: Green by Design: Energy-Guided Reranking of LLM-Generated Programs

contributions.purpose: 把能耗作为一等信号引导代码生成
contributions.mechanism: LLM(Code Llama-70B)采样多候选->正确性过滤->CodeCarbon测能耗->重排选最低能耗
contributions.evaluation: vs Top-1平均省能44.69%(中位39.05%),Wilcoxon p<0.001
contributions.source_quote: we introduce energy-guided reranking of LLM-generated Python programs, using direct energy measurement with CodeCarbon to select efficient implementations

contributions.mechanism: 10任务(数值/排序/字符串/图/IO)三输入规模评测
contributions.evaluation: 矩阵乘最大规模省能>98%;5次重复能耗CV 10.75%
contributions.source_quote: LLMs produce a diverse range of implementations with significant variation in energy consumption

contributions.purpose: 证明省能不牺牲正确性与速度
contributions.mechanism: 对比Best-Time基线的运行时惩罚
contributions.evaluation: vs Best-Time平均省能仅1.86%(中位0),运行时惩罚中位0/均值0.0012s,p=0.0039
contributions.source_quote: energy-guided selection consistently reduces estimated energy use without sacrificing correctness or runtime performance

self_declared_provenance.quote: To our knowledge, no prior work directly integrates energy signals into the act of code generation itself. We address this gap by introducing energy-conditioned decoding, embedding energy awareness into the generative process of LLMs

notes: accept。有intro内3条贡献。trade-off/负结果:vs Best-Time省能仅1.86%且中位0(均值靠长尾拉动),优势微弱;仅3/10任务在各规模保持同一最优候选(30%),提示无通用最优。数据红旗/适配问题:①术语过度声明——abstract称'direct energy measurements',但方法与limitation自认CodeCarbon为model-based估计而非硬件测量(overclaim);②幻影方法——Research Gap宣称'energy-conditioned decoding'嵌入生成过程,实际只是生成后重排/选择(reranking),并非条件解码,claim与实现不符;③作者署名含'ChatGPT 5/OpenAI'与'Gemini 2.5 Pro/Google DeepMind',checklist全[D]。type=method为主。
